frequentlyAskedQuestionsDesc: Everything you need to know about becoming a provider
faq1A: You can showcase your skills and experience in your profile. Some services may require verification of credentials.
faq2Q: How much does it cost to join?
faq2A: Creating an account and listing your services is free. A platform commission is charged on completed bookings.
faq3A: Payments are processed after the customer confirms job completion and the pending period ends.
faqWhoCanBecome: Who can become a service provider on Sewalo?
faqWhoCanBecomeAns: Anyone who offers professional services and meets basic eligibility requirements can join Sewalo. Certain services may require certifications or licenses, which we will guide you through during signup.
faqHowToList: How do I list my services?
faqHowToListAns: Simply create your provider profile, add your service details, set your prices, and indicate your availability. Your services will then be visible to customers in your area.
faqHowReceiveEarnings: How will I receive my earnings?
faqHowReceiveEarningsAns: Sewalo lets you get paid through your preferred method, such as bank deposit or digital wallets. Simply select your preferred option in the financial section when creating your profile, and your earnings will be securely processed.
faqCommission: Does Sewalo charge a commission on my earnings?
faqCommissionAns: Yes, Sewalo applies a small platform fee per booking to support secure payments and maintain the platform. Exact details of fees are provided in your provider agreement and your account dashboard, so you always know what you'll earn.
